panel: many (e.g. rs16 P10, P17, P28; rs17 P12; rs19 P21)
what: Inline code in the numbered 'read it like a detective' lists jumps to its own line as a block whenever it doesn't fit, which leaves a lone comma or full stop at the start of the next line and breaks identifiers in the middle.
evidence: comic.css:233 sets `.readlist code { display: inline-block; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere }`. Measured: code chips forced onto a line of their own at 390: 24 (ch16), 33 (ch17), 23 (ch18), 26 (ch19), 38 (ch20); at 1280: 3–10 per chapter. Examples: rs16 P10 at 390 shows `fs::read_to_string(file_pat` / `h)` and then '. Our message' starting a line; rs17 P12 has a lone ',' on its own line between two code boxes; rs16 P28 has a lone '.'; rs19 P21 at 1280 starts a line with '. Rule 3 promised'. Crops: scratchpad/review-visual-rs-16-20/a16/w390-016-p10.png, a17/w390-021-p12.png, a19/w1280-035-p21.png.
fix: `.readlist code { display: inline-block; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere }` → `.readlist code { display: inline; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: break-word; -webkit-box-decoration-break: clone; box-decoration-break: clone }` (an inline chip wraps with the sentence and keeps its padding and border on each line, so punctuation stays attached and words break only when one token is wider than the line).

what: On phones a stepper's 'Text version: every step' table is 560–698px wide inside a 316px box, so only the Step and Line columns show and every row is hundreds of pixels tall, mostly empty.
evidence: comic-widgets.css:187 `table.transcript { min-width: 560px }`. Measured with every <details> open at 390: rs16 P25 table 5,953px tall (652px wide in a 316px box, tallest row 470px); rs18 P9 5,287px, tallest row 796px; rs16 P14 3,534px. Crops: scratchpad/review-visual-rs-16-20/a16/w390-043-p25.png (slices #1–#4 are nearly blank except the first two columns), a18/w390-016-p9.png.
fix: At ≤640px, stack each row as a small card: `@media (max-width:640px){ table.transcript, table.transcript tbody, table.transcript tr, table.transcript td { display:block; min-width:0 } table.transcript thead { display:none } table.transcript td::before { content: attr(data-h) ': '; font-weight:700 } }`, with the engine writing `data-h` from the header cells when it builds the table (as `.ops.stack` does in rs-ch17/19). Text stays the same; the reader no longer scrolls sideways through 5,000px of blank rows.

file: assets/comic-widgets.js / comic-widgets.css (parsons lines at desktop), seen in rust/ch16, ch18, ch19, ch20
panel: rs16 ex-b1 (after P33), rs18 ex-b1, rs19 ex-b4, rs20 ex-b1
what: Long parsons lines don't wrap on desktop, so their ends disappear under the ↑/↓ buttons: the learner can't read the whole line they are asked to place.
evidence: Measured code scrollWidth > clientWidth at 1280: rs16 boss 1 has 4 hidden lines ('…then make it pass"…', '…check the count and return a Res', '…which returns a Result")', '…process::exit(1)")'); rs18 ex-b1 1 line; rs19 ex-b4 1 line; rs20 ex-b1 2 lines. Crop: scratchpad/review-visual-rs-16-20/v1.png (right half, rs16 boss 1 at 1280). The engine applies the hanging-indent wrap to parsons only on phones (AUTHORING 'Wrapped code lines').
fix: Apply `L.hangLines()` and `white-space: pre-wrap` to parsons line code at every width, and give the code cell `min-width: 0` so it yields to the `.pz` buttons (`grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0,1fr) auto`). Before: `nowrap` + overflow hidden under the arrows → After: wrapped with hanging indent (why: a puzzle piece the reader can't read can't be ordered).

file: assets/comic-widgets.css (stepper controls), seen in rust/ch16, ch17, ch18, ch20
what: In tall steppers the Next/Back buttons sit far below the highlighted code line, so on a phone every press means scrolling up to see the line and down again to press.
evidence: Measured distance from the top of the code list to the Next button: rs17 P21 (39-line walker) 3,025px at 390 and 2,302px at 1280; rs16 P25 2,411px at 390 (1,532 at 1280); rs16 P14 2,079px; rs18 P28 2,218px; rs20 P34 1,823px. The tracer's fixed-size picture adds an empty block under early steps (rs16 P25 step 1: about 1,100px of empty 'objects in memory'). Crops: scratchpad/review-visual-rs-16-20/a16/w390-043-p25.png, a17/w390-038-p21.png.
fix: On phones make the controls row sticky inside its widget: `@media (max-width:640px){ [data-tracer] .controls, [data-walk] .controls, [data-mem] .controls { position: sticky; bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px); z-index: 2; background: var(--background); padding-block: 6px; border-top: 3px solid var(--border) } }` (keyboard arrows already work on desktop; on a phone the buttons stay under the thumb).

panel: rs16 P25 line 17; rs17 P11 line 8; rs18 P9 line 14; rs19 P25 line 6
what: The '◀ next' marker wraps onto a line of its own under a long highlighted line, making the yellow highlight a line taller and leaving the marker detached from the code.
evidence: Crops: scratchpad/review-visual-rs-16-20/a16/w390-043-p25.png (line 17 'let config = Config { ◀' then 'next' alone), a17/w390-020-p11.png, a18/w390-016-p9.png, a19/w390-047-p25.png.
fix: Pin the marker to the right edge instead of flowing it after the text: `.tr-code li.now::after { position: absolute; right: 6px; top: 4px; white-space: nowrap }` with `position: relative; padding-right: 4.5em` on the current line.

file: assets/comic.js (L.hangLines break opportunities), seen in rust/ch17 and ch19
panel: rs19 P25 line 7; rs17 P21 line 29
what: The hanging-indent wrapper adds break points after '.' and '(' even inside string and char literals, so a literal is split across lines.
evidence: rs19 P25 tracer at 390 shows `let first = story.split('.` / `').next().unwrap();` (the char literal '.' is cut in two); rs17 P21 walker shows `String::from("bee` / `p...")`. Crops: scratchpad/review-visual-rs-16-20/a19/w390-047-p25.png, a17/w390-038-p21.png.
fix: In hangLines, skip `<wbr>` insertion between an opening quote and its closing quote (track `"` and `'` state while scanning the line).

panel: rust/ch20 words page (and any long term)
what: The glossary grid sizes its term column to the longest term's max-content width with no cap, so one long term can take the whole width and squeeze every definition to nothing.
evidence: comic.css:295 `.terms { grid-template-columns: max-content minmax(0, 1fr) }`. rust/ch20's error-code term (85 characters of code font) makes the 'Words from this chapter' page 49,660px tall at 1280 and pushes the term column 77px past the page edge. Crop: scratchpad/review-visual-rs-16-20/v12.png. rust/ch18's 45-character term leaves its definitions about 250px wide.
fix: `grid-template-columns: max-content minmax(0, 1fr)` → `grid-template-columns: fit-content(14em) minmax(0, 1fr)` plus `.terms dt { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere }` (a long term wraps inside its column instead of eating the definitions).

panel: every spot, parsons, fill and trace exercise; every map/timeline road button

evidence: Measured at 390: `.spot-line` buttons 40px tall (44 per ch16), `.pz` arrows 40×34 (30 per ch16), `.ex-cell`/`.ex-blank` inputs 28px tall, `.path-btn` 42px tall, `<summary>` triggers 32px tall. audit.json `taps` in scratchpad/review-visual-rs-16-20/a16..a20.

panel: cover, P2, P8, P12, P18, P21, P26, P36 (.part-pop/.slide-in)
what: The figure entrances are slower and bigger than the motion budget: each part pops from scale(0.6) over 600ms with a 150ms stagger (the last part finishes 1.5s after the panel appears), and `.slide-in` takes 800ms after a 300ms delay.
evidence: rs-ch16.css:80-86: `ch16-pop 0.6s ease-out` from `scale(0.6)` overshooting to 1.06, delays .d1–.d6 = 0.15s–0.9s; `ch16-slide 0.8s ease-out 0.3s` from translateX(-30px). DESIGN_SYSTEM §5: entrances start at 0.9–0.97, ≤300ms, `--ease-out`; Emil: stagger 30–80ms. 13 .part-pop and 3 .slide-in elements on the page. Reduced motion and 'Animations: off' do stop them (comic.css:332, :337).
fix: `.motion .panel.played .part-pop { animation: ch16-pop 0.6s ease-out both }` with `scale(0.6)`→1.06 and 150ms steps → `animation: ch16-pop var(--dur-ui) var(--ease-out) both` with keyframes `from { transform: scale(0.95); opacity: 0 }`, `.d1`–`.d6` delays 50ms apart; `.slide-in` → `240ms var(--ease-out)` from `translateX(-12px)` (rare, decorative motion can stay, but it must finish in the time a reader glances at the figure).

what: The timeline introduces colours that aren't tokens and an `!important` override, and other cards are hand-rolled.
evidence: `.life-legend .sw` and `.lf-cell.on.owner` use `#E8D3B0`, `.loan` uses `#C9F2D9`/`#FFFFFF` (= --mint/--paper written raw), `.lf-codehead { font: … !important }` (lines 105, 135); rs-ch19.js hard-codes `RED = "#B00020"`; `.rules li`, `.choose2 > div` are cards with radius 12px, `.sigcard` radius 10px; `.page-body details` rules duplicate the engine.
fix: Use `var(--mint)`, `var(--paper)`, `var(--error)`; add the owner tan as a palette token or reuse `--sketch-paper`; replace `!important` with a more specific selector (`.lf-head .lf-code`); radii → `var(--radius-lg)`.

what: The glossary page is unreadable on desktop: one 85-character term (the list of eleven error codes) takes the whole term column, so every definition is squeezed to zero width and the open page is 49,660px tall.
evidence: The dt holds `E0308 / E0434 / E0502 / E0382 / E0594 / E0596 / E0782 / E0373 / E0599 / E0283 / E0282` in code font; with `.terms { grid-template-columns: max-content minmax(0,1fr) }` (comic.css:295) the term column is wider than the page (audit: every dt sticks out 77px on the right). Crop: scratchpad/review-visual-rs-16-20/v12.png (only 'closure' visible, then blank ruled lines). At 390 the engine stacks terms, so phones are fine.
fix: Shorten the term to `error codes (E0308 … E0282)` and put the full list in the definition, or split it into one row per code; the engine fix (`fit-content(14em)`) is in the visual-engine finding.

what: The long-form anatomy card `|x: i32| -> i32 { x + 1 }` refuses to wrap, which widens the panel's content 5px past its right border, so the caption, cards, checklist and bubble all lose their right edge.
evidence: rs-ch20.css:61 `.anatomy > div > code { font: 800 1.3rem var(--f-code); white-space: nowrap }`. audit 'beyond' at 390: p.caption.soft, div.anatomy, ul.checklist, div.scene each end 5px past the panel. Crop: scratchpad/review-visual-rs-16-20/f20/s00.png (second column).
fix: `.anatomy > div > code { white-space: nowrap }` → `white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word`, plus `@media (max-width:640px){ .anatomy > div > code { font-size: 1.1rem } }` and `.anatomy > div { min-width: 0; max-width: 100% }`.

what: The belt redraws on every step and replays a 450ms slide on the moving item each time, including arrow-key steps.
evidence: rs-ch20.css:78-81 `.motion .belt-svg .belt-item { animation: ch20-slide 0.45s ease-out both }` from `translateX(-26px); opacity: 0.2`; rs-ch20.js:190 rebuilds the SVG with innerHTML on each render, so a fresh `.belt-item` (and its keyframe) is created on every press. (A headless getAnimations() probe right after stepping returned no running animation, so the replay is inferred from the CSS and JS, not observed.) Emil: keyboard-initiated repeated actions get little or no motion; UI ≤300ms.
fix: `animation: ch20-slide 0.45s ease-out` from `-26px` → `animation: ch20-slide var(--dur-ui) var(--ease-out) both` from `translateX(-10px); opacity: 0` (narrow: `translateY(-10px)`), and skip it when the step came from a key press (or delete it: the dashed 'hot station' outline already shows where the item is).

what: Same slow entrances as rust/ch16 and ch18: parts pop from scale(0.6) over 600ms with 150ms steps, up to 1.5s per figure; 13 parts on this page.
fix: `ch20-pop 0.6s ease-out` from `scale(0.6)` → `var(--dur-ui) var(--ease-out)` from `scale(0.95); opacity: 0`, delays 50ms apart.

what: The backpack's name tags ('closure', 'look', 'tally', 'shout') are 9.8px and its flap words '&MUT'/'USED' 11px at the default character size.
evidence: rs-ch20.js:70 tag text font-size 15 in a 200-unit viewBox; :60 flap words 20 units. audit small-text list for a20. Crop: scratchpad/review-visual-rs-16-20/f20/s00.png (cover and P6).
fix: Tag text 15 → 20 units (widen the tag rect to `lab.length * 13 + 18`), flap words 20 → 24.

what: The definition card in P20 and the table in P24 scroll sideways on phones without a cue.
evidence: audit scrollers at 390: `.defcard` 582px in 310px (P20); `.ops-wrap` 415px in 316px (P24), caused by `.ops td:first-child code { white-space: nowrap }` (rs-ch20.css:33).
fix: Same defcard phone rule as rust/ch16 P8; scope the nowrap rule to `@media (min-width: 641px)` as line 102 already does for other cells.

what: Hand-rolled cards and tables with raw radii and shadows instead of tokens.
evidence: `.anatomy > div` (card, radius 10px), `.defcard` (radius 10px, `4px 4px 0`), `.ops`/`.oscmd` tables (radius 10px), duplicated `.panel > details` rules; belt and backpack fills are raw hex (fills only, text stays ink).
fix: radii → `var(--radius-lg)`, shadow → `var(--shadow-hard)`; delete the `.panel > details` rules.
